A NEIGHBORHOOD WORTH LEARNING

The Broken
Delivery Loop.

A parcel. A blue door latched from the far side. A workshop you can see, but have yet to reach.

Follow the market, cross the drying terraces, or take the canal. Restore a useful connection, then find your way home.

Preparing the neighborhood...

Continue original neighborhood & saved routesOriginal saves are kept separately and never overwritten.

Playable authored graybox / v0.12.1. Desktop, Xbox and spatial XR. Physical headset testing remains open.

Street: follow the arcade north. Roof: enter the public print-shop stair on foot. Canal: Y boards at either public pier. The north quay loading cart responds to a local signal: L3 bell or X at the approach post. The marked north loop stays rideable without waiting; roof and canal bypass loading. The pump changes the canal between boating and maintenance access. Deliver the parcel and restore either connection, then return to the depot.
